name: Franken-Castle

abilityDetails.Unstoppable: Saldırılar sırasında sersemleme ve geri itilmeye karşı bağışıklık sağlar.
abilityDetails.Crush: Blokları kırarak yüksek hasar vermeyi sağlar.
abilityDetails.Incinerate: Zamanla enerji tabanlı yakma hasarı verir ve zırhı yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Passive Stun: Belirli şartlarda rakibi tetikleme olmadan sersemletir.
abilityDetails.Undying: Hasar veren etkiler ve Power Sting ile elenmeyi engeller.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Ana tehlike pasif durdurulamaz olması (ileri yürürken) — durdurulamaz-karşıtı şampiyon kullan. Zehir, spectre ve petrify'a immün, iyileşmesi tersine çevrilemez — sadece iyileşme engeli işe yarar.
signatureAbility:
Undead and Hating It
When Frank activates a Special Attack, he gains an Undying Passive for [5 - 10] seconds. If this Undying prevents him from being Knocked Out, he gains his personal Rage Debuff for 20 seconds.
Frank gains +[142.44 - 687.5] Critical Rating for each non-Damaging Debuff he is suffering from, up to 10.
While the Opponent is Incinerated, Frank gains +[479.57 - 2,250] Energy Penetration, doubled while fighting Science Champions.
immunityDetails:
• Zehir Bağışıklığı 🧪
• İyileşme Tersine Çevirmeye dirençli 💚🔄❌

abilitySections.title: Dr. Morbin-stein's Monster - Always Active
content: The reanimation process grants Immunity to Poison, Petrify, and Spectre effects. This also sets Frank's Regeneration Rate to 65%, and prevents it from being reduced any further.
Being too angry to die grants Frank Rank 1 of the Willpower Mastery.

When struck by a Basic Attack while Unstoppable, or when Shocked, Frank gains a non-stacking Rage Debuff for 20 seconds. With Rage, Frank's Basic Attack hits Passively convert a flat 10% more Adrenaline to Health.
When Frank is inflicted with or Immune to a non-Damaging Debuff other than Rage, his Combo Meter gains 2 hits.
When Frank's Combo Meter crosses a multiple of 15, he gains a +[3,524.85] Berserk Passive for 20 seconds, paused during his Special Attacks. Max stacks: 6.

abilitySections.title: Unstoppable Machine - While Running
content: Frank does not idle after Dodging back, and gains an Unstoppable Passive for 0.7 seconds when he starts to run. This will not re-trigger while active, and is paused while running, charging Heavy Attacks, or attacking.
Frank's Unstoppable also grants him +30% Combat Adrenaline, and it prevents incoming Basic Attacks from resetting his Combo Meter. As an Attacker, it also grants him Stun Immunity.

As an Attacker, Frank also gains his Unstoppable when he is struck by a Basic Attack immediately after Dodging back. He also gains it, plus the ability to run immediately, after Blocking the final hit of the Opponent's Special Attacks.
This Unstoppable is immediately removed at the end of Frank's Heavy or Special Attacks, and when the Opponent activates a Special Attack.

abilitySections.title: Crushing Blows - During Frank's Unstoppable
content: On hit or on Block as an Attacker, Frank's second Basic Attack inflicts an indefinite Crush Passive until his Unstoppable expires.
When Frank's Crush ends after being used to Break a Block, it goes on cooldown for 20 seconds, or until he gains 1 of his Berserk Passives.

abilitySections.title: External Combustion - Heavy Attack
content: On hit, Frank's Heavy Attack inflicts an Incinerate Debuff that deals [7,049.7] Energy Damage over 20 seconds, paused during his Special Attacks. Max stacks: 4.
On hit or Block, Frank's Heavy Attack also adds 4 hits to his Combo Meter.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1 - The Samaritans
content: The first hit grants Frank a personal Berserk Passive.
On the final 3 hits, Frank deals a burst of [5,035.5] Energy Damage with its base potency increased by +12.5% flat for each of his Incinerates on the Opponent.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2 - This Is My Best Weapon
content: The first 4 hits each grant Frank a personal Berserk Passive.
The final hit refreshes all of Frank's Incinerates, and then inflicts 8 Incinerate Debuffs that each deal [7,049.7] Energy Damage over 30 seconds, paused during his Special Attacks. Max stacks: 8.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3 - It's Aliiiive!
content: Frank gains 15% of missing Health as Adrenaline, and Passively Stuns the Opponent for 3 seconds.
For the next 10 seconds, Frank's Light and Medium Attacks inflict 1 of the Incinerates from his Special Attack 2.
